Several days (each task has a 20-hour cooldown)

{npc:The Draccoon} escaped the clutches of the insatiable dragon Nimmersatt disguised as a cook and now wants revenge. Help him in a series of tasks all over Tibia — hunting the essence of Ratha, launching the Fryclops from a catapult, stealing crystals from demons, deciphering the language of the bonelords, sabotaging a bulltaur invasion and bringing down the Titano Dragon. At the end you earn the base outfits **Draccoon Herald**, access to the {wiki:Bulltaur Lair} and to {wiki:Nimmersatt's Breeding Ground}, with the boss {wiki:Dragon Hoard}.

Fleeing the clutches of Nimmersatt, the insatiable dragon, the Draccoon used their culinary talents as a disguise. Now free and driven by revenge, they are looking for allies. Join the Draccoon to uncover Nimmersatt's sinister plan and stop his terror from devouring the realm.
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 350+**.
Access to **Meriana** (mission "The Errand" of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest} completed).
Several tasks have a time limit (9–10 minutes) and are very hard alone: go in a **team**.
to hand over to the Draccoon after you break the Sword of Fury (Charged Machine task)
several, recommended for the Adventurers Bane (damage reflection)
optional, alternative for the Adventurers Nemesis
to go down beneath the Plains of Havoc graveyard (Bulltaur Lair)
Access to {wiki:Nimmersatt's Breeding Ground} and the boss {wiki:Dragon Hoard}
Mission 9 (*Bulltaur Lair*): a new {item:Ominous Trashcan}, 1 floor below the graveyard of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} (near the entrance of {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest}), takes you to the lair.
At the end of the quest (mission 12, *Gratitude and Breeding Ground*): a new {item:Ominous Trashcan} in the {wiki:Temple of Equilibrium}, in the {wiki:Muggy Plains} (Zao), takes you there.
The teleport from the Zao Steppe to the Muggy Plains only works after the first 8 missions of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
With the quest done, in the lever room of Nimmersatt's Breeding Ground.
Seven dragons, one at a time, in 15 minutes.
That quest requires the 20 Years a Cook Quest to be completed, which gives you the base outfit Draccoon Herald.
**All tasks have a 20-hour cooldown.** If an attempt goes wrong, give up and regroup the next day.
The Ghost Hunt, Revenge Best Served Fried!, Charged Machine and Pirate Ship tasks last 10 minutes at most; Bonelord Language 9 minutes. Plan with the team before you start.
Always return to {npc:The Draccoon}'s lair in Venore (through the {item:Ominous Trashcan} in the dumpster) and say {key:mission} to update the quest and receive the next task.

Go to **Venore** (by boat: say {key:hi}, {key:venore} and {key:yes} to the harbour captain in your city) and head for the **southwest** exit. Go down the stairs and go right **south** of where {npc:Appaloosa} is. There you find a ramp going up to {npc:Cheaty}. Talk to him ({key:hi}, {key:talk}): he tells you the Draccoon is back after a long absence and needs help. Accept the mission.
Area of the ramp up to Cheaty
Going down to the Venore dumpster
Go to the Venore dumpster, going down here.
Way down to the Venore dumpster

In the dumpster, walk a little **east** and step on the {item:Ominous Trashcan}: you are teleported to {npc:The Draccoon}'s room. To leave the lair, go back the way you came in and climb out of the dumpster into the city.
Asking the Draccoon for the mission
Ask him for a {key:mission}. He tells you that {wiki:Nimmersatt} locked him up there to devour him, but that he prolonged his life by becoming one of the dragon's cooks. Now he wants revenge.
All tasks in this quest have a **20-hour cooldown**.

Kazordoon has no boat. Go by {wiki:Magic Carpet|flying carpet} (for example from Edron, which you reach by boat from Venore): say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} and {key:yes} to the carpet manager; you arrive at the carpet at the top of the Kazordoon mountain. You can also go by {wiki:Steamship} (from {wiki:Cormaya} with {npc:Gurbasch} or from Farmine with {npc:Thorgrin}: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}) and you arrive at the underground harbour, next to {npc:Brodrosch}. Inside the city you can use the {wiki:Ore Wagon|Ore Wagons} (250 gp licence) to get to the depot.
Going to the blue teleporter in Kazordoon
The Draccoon sends you to **Kazordoon** to warn an old friend of his return. Go up **three floors** from the depot (the same floor as {npc:Sigurd}) and go to a **light blue** teleporter. Step on it.
You arrive in a room with {creature:The Rest of Ratha} (a headless skeleton). Approach and stay next to the skeleton until you get the message to return to the Draccoon.
The room with The Rest of Ratha
Fun fact: The Rest of Ratha is the body the old {item:Skull of Ratha} item belonged to.

Leave Ratha's room the way you came in. To get back to Venore, take the Kazordoon flying carpet ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}) and, in Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}). Go back to the Draccoon's lair in Venore and say {key:mission} to update the quest.
The Draccoon thinks it is still possible to communicate with Ratha by using a friend's tools to "extract" his essence. Task with a **10-minute** (600 s) time limit — hard to finish in time alone.
Go back to Kazordoon and step on the same light blue teleporter. This time you go to a room with a lever, where the first task begins. Use the lever to start.
All the equipment is in the **southeast** corner of the room (except the harp). In a box next to the {item:Ghost Duster (Ratha)} you find the {item:Spirit Container (Ratha-Empty)|small container}.
Firing the Ghost Duster at Ratha

Position the {item:Ghost Duster (Ratha)} so that its beam hits Ratha. The duster **only fires when a player deals damage**: when Ratha is close, mages and paladins should attack him from range. Damage-over-time spells help a lot: {spell:Inflict Wound}, {spell:Ignite}, {spell:Curse}, {spell:Envenom} and {spell:Holy Flash}.
Ratha teleports around the room a lot. Play the {item:Harp} in the **middle of the room** to draw him back — it only works **3 times**.

When the beam hits Ratha, he drops essences on the floor. Pick them up with the {item:Spirit Container (Ratha-Empty)} and deposit them in the big container. Repeat until the big container reaches **50**: the task is then complete.
When you are done, leave the task area the way you came in. Return to the Draccoon in Venore (Kazordoon flying carpet to Edron and boat from Edron to Venore) and say {key:mission}.

The Draccoon received the vial with Ratha's essences and a potion for talking to spirits in the mail, and asks you to fetch it from the shelf and drink it. Use his **rack**: by accident, you drink Ratha's essences instead of the potion, and you start to "hear" Ratha, who also reads your mind.
Tell the Draccoon what happened ({key:mission}). He says he will sort it out, but that he has other things to take care of first.
To get rid of Ratha's messages, use the rack a second time to "extract him from your mind" — only possible after you receive the final reward.

Get Nimmersatt's head chef, {creature:The Fryclops}, out of the way; he lives on a small island north of Carlin sinking ships as a hobby (information from {npc:Bozo}). Task with a **10-minute** time limit.

Go to **Carlin** (from Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless}'s boat: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}). **West** of the city, enter the {wiki:Ghostlands} by going under the wall through the marked hole and head **south**, to next to the abandoned house. The Draccoon puts an {item:Ominous Trashcan} there that is a secret passage to the Fryclops's island. Use it.
Hole under the wall to the Ghostlands
On the island another lever task begins. First, lure the Fryclops so that its beam hits the {item:Locked Door} in the **north** wall of the room. It takes **4 beams** to destroy the door.
Suggested position to destroy the door
With the door destroyed, go out to the courtyard and take the {item:Fryclops Axe} from the chest.
Where to get the Fryclops Axe
Put the Fryclops on top of the **catapult**. When he is there, use the axe to cut the rope and launch him far away.
Launching the Fryclops on the catapult

When you are done, leave the task area the way you came in. Leave the Ghostlands through the hole in the wall, take {npc:Captain Greyhound}'s boat in Carlin ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and go back to the Draccoon and say {key:mission}.
With the Fryclops out of the way, the Draccoon has access to the machine in his cellar, but it needs hellish power crystals — which you are going to steal from unsuspecting demons.

Go to **Edron** (from Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless}'s boat: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}); you arrive at the harbour next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. Near the {wiki:Stone Circle}, next to an abandoned tower, there is an {item:Ominous Trashcan} that leads to the task.
Ominous Trashcan next to the Stone Circle

During the task you are disguised by a spell from {npc:Cheaty} (something harmless and uninteresting). Run to the **northwest** part of the room, use the crystal boxes to pick up an {item:Immensely Powerful Crystal} and run back to the entrance to store it in the {item:Crystal Collection Box}. Repeat until you have **50 crystals**.

You have **200 seconds** on entering, plus **10 seconds** for each crystal delivered (the timer is personal and you see the countdown above you). With a crystal in hand you become "drunk with power" and walk like a drunk until you deliver it; a {item:Dwarven Ring} doesn't help.
Nothing in the room attacks you, but you still take damage reflection from {creature:Morshabaal} and the {creature:Ominous Pillar|Ominous Pillars}. Ignore everything and don't attack anything.
With the 50 crystals, leave the room the way you came in and go back to Venore ({npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and say {key:mission} to the Draccoon.
Task with a **10-minute** time limit, done as a group.

Go back to the {wiki:Ghostlands} and use the **left** trashcan to get to the Fryclops's cellar. The route there is the same as in section 5 (Carlin, hole under the wall, abandoned house). At the end, leave the way you came in.

One player uses the lever next to the Draccoon to start. Then use the **ten levers** in the centre of the room: the right lever is the one that gives off **green sparks** and makes the sound *<Tick>*. The machine produces, in this order: {item:Worn Leather Boots}, {item:Fire Sword}, {item:Crown}, {item:Ferumbras' Hat}, {item:The Famous Sword of Fury} and {item:The Broken Sword of Fury}.
Put one player in charge of the top row and another of the bottom row, so two of you don't click the same lever at the same time.
When using the machine you accidentally break the {item:Sword of Fury}. Take a new {item:Spike Sword} to the Draccoon as a replacement and say {key:mission}.
The Draccoon paid a mad scientist to decipher the {wiki:469|bonelord language}. Task with a **9-minute** (540 s) time limit, to do all 3 floors.

Travel to {wiki:Quirefang}: take a boat to {wiki:Gray Island} in Ab'Dendriel, Venore, Darashia or Edron ({key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes}, 150 gp) and go down the island's **only hole**; an underground passage takes you to Quirefang, near **Gray Beach**. There, use the {item:Ominous Trashcan} to reach the scientist, **Professor Rudebert Evul**. He asks you to prove your worth by cleaning his cellar: there are **3 floors**.
Whenever a floor is cleared, at least one player has to **run back up** to the floor above and approach the professor to unlock the next floor for everyone.
Kill the {creature:Cellar Rat|Cellar Rats}. They shouldn't cause problems if you come prepared.

This floor is full of {creature:Adventurers Bane}, creatures that look like {item:Crate|crates} and have **very high damage reflection**. Attack them slowly, with {item:Stone Skin Amulet} and {item:Might Ring} equipped, and adjust your pace to how well your character handles the reflection.
If you are taking too long, it is better to give up and regroup after the 20-hour cooldown: you have to do all 3 floors within the time.

Similar to the previous one, but with {creature:Adventurers Nemesis}, which look like {item:Barrel|barrels}: slightly lower reflection but more health. It may be viable to use {item:Gill Necklace} and {item:Might Ring} — do whatever is safest for your character.

With all three floors cleared, return to the surface. As the professor is about to reveal the secret, the Fryclops falls from the sky on top of him and both die. Report to the Draccoon ({key:mission}).

Leave the professor's cellar the way you came in, return to Gray Beach and take the underground passage in reverse to {wiki:Gray Island}. Talk to {npc:Scrutinon}: he takes you **for free** to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Edron or Venore ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}).
The bulltaurs plan to invade Rookgaard through a portal to the temple. You have to find the machine and reprogram it to send the invasion to a city of {creature:Bonelord|bonelords}.
The trashcan near the Pits of Inferno

A new trashcan takes you to the {wiki:Bulltaur Lair}. Leave Venore to the **southwest** to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} and go to the graveyard near the {wiki:Necromant House}. The trashcan is **1 floor below** the graveyard, near the entrance to {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest} (the cave beneath the graveyard is opened by digging a {item:Loose Stone Pile} with a {item:Shovel}).
The lair is full of {creature:Bulltaur Brute|Bulltaur Brutes}, {creature:Bulltaur Alchemist|Bulltaur Alchemists} and {creature:Bulltaur Forgepriest|Bulltaur Forgepriests}.
From the trashcan, go from the starting point to the way down to the next floor.
Keep going to the next way down.
Keep going to the next way down.
Follow the path to the end and **use the machine**.

After using the machine, go back through the same 4 floors to the point where you arrived by the trashcan and leave the way you came in. Return to Venore through the Plains of Havoc, to the **northeast**.
Go back to the Draccoon and say {key:mission}.
The Draccoon wants to use gnomish technology to teleport to the Serpentine Tower treasure chamber in Ankrahmun. You have to triangulate the coordinates.

Go to **Ankrahmun** by boat (from Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}); you arrive at the harbour next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}. Go next to the **north** exit of the city and talk to the {npc:Secretive Rascoohan} (who is Airclairebear in disguise). He gives you a {item:Ley Triangulator}.
From here you have **5 minutes** to mark the three points.
Go to the three points in the city marked on the map to triangulate the coordinates.
After marking the points, use the trashcan and the lever to enter the tower's treasure chamber. Use the lever and **stay in the room** until the Quest Log updates.
When you are done, leave the task area the way you came in. Return to Venore by boat ({npc:Captain Sinbeard}: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and to the Draccoon's lair and say {key:mission}.
Nimmersatt has a secret base where he breeds dragons and created the {creature:Titano Dragon}, bigger than a ship and almost ready to fly. Task with a **10-minute** time limit.

Go to **Liberty Bay** (from Venore, take {npc:Captain Fearless}'s boat: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}). On the small peninsula **southeast** of the depot, talk to {npc:Captain Waverider} and say {key:hi}, {key:peg leg} and {key:yes}: he takes you to Sabrehaven, in {wiki:Meriana}, for 50 gp. There, talk to **Rascalio**, who will get you a ship to take on the dragon.

Use the lever to start and use the docks to get a {item:Balista Bolt}. Sail **west** until you find a {creature:Pirate Ship}. Use the bolt on it (as if you were using a rune) to destroy it. Loot the ship and you get an {item:Enchanted Balista Bolt}.
Head **north** and repeat the process with the enchanted bolt to kill the {creature:Titano Dragon}.
Avoid the dragon's waves and don't stay close to the {creature:Storm|Storms}.

When you are done, leave the task area the same way you came in. To return to **Liberty Bay**, go to {npc:Sebastian}, **south** of Sabrehaven, and say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} and {key:yes} (50 gp). In Liberty Bay take {npc:Jack Fate}'s boat to Venore ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}).
Return to Draccoon's lair and say {key:mission}.

Draccoon says the world is safer but that the {wiki:Nimmersatt's Breeding Ground} is still dangerous. Ask him for another {key:mission} and then say {key:gratitude}: he names you a herald and you can now use the **Draccoon Herald** outfits.
You can now use the potion shelf again to extract Ratha from your mind.

You also gain access to a new {item:Ominous Trashcan} in {wiki:Zao}, at the {wiki:Temple of Equilibrium}, which leads to the Breeding Ground. To get there: go to Farmine by {wiki:Steamship} ({npc:Brodrosch} in Kazordoon or {npc:Gurbasch} in Cormaya: {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}), head out to the Zao steppe and use the old lizard teleport in the **north** of the steppe to reach the {wiki:Muggy Plains} (it only works after the first 8 missions of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}). The {wiki:Temple of Equilibrium} is in the north of the Muggy Plains. To return, take the same route in reverse to Farmine and catch the Steamship from {npc:Thorgrin} ({key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}).

With the quest done, in the Breeding Ground you will find {creature:Wardragon|Wardragons}, {creature:Dragolisk|Dragolisks} and {creature:Mega Dragon|Mega Dragons}. Cross the hunting area to the boss lever.
Follow on from the starting point to the passage to the next floor.
Continue to the boss lever room.

Use the levers and defeat **seven dragons**, one at a time, within **15 minutes**. Each dragon has a special trait. When you kill one, its trait **is passed on to all the following dragons** (e.g. if you kill {creature:Vengar} first, the other six start casting Fear). **Resistances are not passed on**: if you kill {creature:Greedok} first, you can keep using death damage on the rest.
Immune to fire; healed by earth
Immune to fire; healed by death
Immune to fire; healed by ice

Analyse the team's vocations and plan the order. Killing **Bruton** first is recommended, so you don't end up with several bosses with his self-heal. Since he is immune to physical, Royal Paladins should bring a cheap secondary crossbow (e.g. {item:Rift Crossbow}) with a strong elemental imbuement such as {wiki:Powerful Reap}. If you have lower-level Elder Druids and Master Sorcerers, avoid killing Greedok first.
With the seven dragons dead, open the treasure chest **south** of the room and collect the loot.
In the Bosstiary and in the daily boss with bonus, the boss appears as **Dragon Pack** with Despor's image; the bonus applies regardless of which dragon is killed last.

With the loot, go back through the same two floors to the starting point (where you arrived through the trashcan) and leave the same way you came in, to the {wiki:Temple of Equilibrium}. From there go back through the Muggy Plains and the lizard teleport to the Zao steppe and Farmine.
Cheaty disguises you during the In Charge task — that is why the demons don't attack you.
The Rest of Ratha is linked to the old item {item:Skull of Ratha}, from {wiki:The Explorer Society Quest}.
